C++ — Camera Configuration

Correspond camera_config.cpp.

API Reference

getConfig(ip, configJson)

Purpose: Reads the current full parameter scheme.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

configJson

nlohmann::json &

Camera configuration.

Returns: bool.

setConfig(ip, configJson)

Purpose: Apply the whole scheme to the camera.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

configJson

const nlohmann::json &

Camera configuration.

Returns: bool; true indicates that the configuration has been applied.

getParameterList(ip, presets)

Purpose: Reads all parameter presets.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

presets

std::vector<SimpleCameraParameter> &

Value of presets.

Returns: bool;writing when successful presets.

setParameter(ip, paramId)

Purpose: Press ID Switches the current parameter scheme.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

paramId

const std::string &

Parameter preset Id.

Returns: bool; true This indicates that the switch was successful.

getConfigStyle(ip, styleJson)

Purpose: Reads the configuration metadata for the current machine type.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

styleJson

nlohmann::json &

Value of styleJson.

Returns: bool. == Example

nlohmann::json config;
if (!TFTech::EpicEye::getConfig(ip, config)) return;

if (config.contains("structuredLightParams")) {
    config["structuredLightParams"]["projectorBrightness"] = 50;
}

if (!TFTech::EpicEye::setConfig(ip, config)) {
    std::cerr << "apply config failed\n";
}
